title: (-)-α-Bisabolol GC Sample Preparation
author: Dennis DD Dienst
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xiufkew

steps.title: Observe dodecane safety
steps.instruction: Because dodecane is toxic, wear protective gloves and goggles, and work under a fume hood or use a respirator. Refer to https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/dodecane#section=Handling-and-Storage for details.

steps.title: Store stock solutions
steps.instruction: Store all stock solutions in a refrigerator at approximately 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare external standard series
steps.instruction: Create a dilution series of (-)-α‑bisabolol external standard at the following concentrations (µg·µL⁻¹): 0, 12.5, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400, 800. Use the high‑range dilution scheme below, preparing two identical vials for each concentration.

substeps.instruction: 800 µg·mL⁻¹: add 400 µL Stock II and 0 µL Stock C (final volume 200 µL) – prepare 2 vials.
400 µg·mL⁻¹: add 250 µL Stock II and 250 µL Stock C (final volume 200 µL) – prepare 2 vials.
200 µg·mL⁻¹: add 125.0 µL Stock II and 375.0 µL Stock C (final volume 200 µL) – prepare 2 vials.
100 µg·mL⁻¹: add 62.5 µL Stock II and 437.5 µL Stock C (final volume 200 µL) – prepare 2 vials.
50 µg·mL⁻¹: add 31.25 µL Stock II and 468.75 µL Stock C (final volume 200 µL) – prepare 2 vials.
25 µg·mL⁻¹: add 15.63 µL Stock II and 484.38 µL Stock C (final volume 200 µL) – prepare 2 vials.
0 µg·mL⁻¹: add 0.0 µL Stock II and 500.0 µL Stock C (final volume 200 µL) – prepare 2 vials.
Total volumes used: Stock II = 884.375 µL, Stock C = 2 515.625 µL.

steps.title: Load sample into GC vial
steps.instruction: Pipette 198 µL of the prepared sample into a GC vial, then add 2 µL of Stock B to the same vial.
